aknn_real_pois.description: AkNN query performance on real-world POI sets (Figure 5 from paper). Query time in ms. Lower is better.

p50_query_time_ms.description: Median query latency — catches methods that improve extremes but worsen typical-case latency.

p10_query_time_ms.description: Fast-quartile query latency — catches methods that optimize for easy queries at the expense of median performance.

p90_query_time_ms.description: Tail query latency on the same query family; catches methods that improve the mean by leaving hard queries slow.

accuracy.description: Exact-match correctness against brute force; prevents faster but incorrect nearest-neighbor results from scoring well.

speedup_over_brute.description: Relative speed versus exact brute-force validation, tying latency gains to a method-independent baseline.

aknn_sensitivity_density.description: AkNN query behavior at the saved density point d=0.001. The reproduction artifacts do not include a full density sweep, so this experiment is down-weighted to a single-density anchor instead of a full scaling claim.

p50_query_time_ms.description: Median query latency under density variation; catches density-specific tuning that worsens typical-case performance.

p10_query_time_ms.description: Fast-quartile query latency under density variation.

p90_query_time_ms.description: Tail query latency under density variation; catches density-specific tuning that hides slow hard queries.

accuracy.description: Exact-match correctness against brute force under the density setting; protects the scalability claim from pruning errors.

speedup_over_brute.description: Relative speed versus exact brute-force validation for the density setting.

kfn_real_pois.description: kFN query performance on real-world POI sets (Figure 10 from paper). kFN cannot be solved by IER; only COLT-PHL vs AUB-PHL baseline.

p50_query_time_ms.description: Median kFN latency; catches methods that exploit easy query vertices while degrading typical-case performance.

p90_query_time_ms.description: Tail k farthest-neighbor latency; catches methods that only optimize easy query vertices.

accuracy.description: Exact-match correctness against brute force; required because k farthest-neighbor pruning can otherwise omit true farthest objects.

speedup_over_brute.description: Relative speed versus exact brute-force validation for k farthest-neighbor queries.

range_real_pois.description: Range query performance on real-world POI sets (Figure 12 from paper). COLT-PHL achieves 2.7x improvement on largest POI sets.

p50_query_time_ms.description: Median range-query latency; catches methods fast on sparse results but slow on typical cases.

p90_query_time_ms.description: Tail range-query latency; catches shortcuts that are fast only for sparse result sets.

accuracy.description: Exact-match correctness against brute force; ensures range queries do not trade recall for speed.

speedup_over_brute.description: Relative speed versus exact brute-force validation for range queries.

preprocessing.description: Preprocessing overhead amortized against slice-specific query workload. The reported SUL-Tree and COL-Tree times are the slice-assigned shares of mean build cost, with an additional build-to-query ratio for context.

build_query_ratio.description: Mean preprocessing time divided by total query time on the scored slice; captures whether index build overhead stays amortized over actual workload.

sul_time_s.description: Mean SUL-Tree preprocessing time across saved runs — the auxiliary-index build overhead.

col_time_s.description: Mean COL-Tree preprocessing time across saved runs — the core method build overhead.
